MITRE ATT&CK® Enterprise 20.0: the ids, tactics and names are MITRE's, from the pinned list [`attack-enterprise-20.0.tsv`](attack-enterprise-20.0.tsv) (bundle `enterprise-attack/enterprise-attack-20.0.json` of https://github.com/mitre-attack/attack-stix-data at commit `20664a889568dce884a1dac0ec7b12ae3a199f51`, sha256 `81113ba98afa2928f3dcff62022539f7ce30c315c32e14422f11ff95ce534352`), under the ATT&CK Terms of Use ([`LICENSES/MITRE_ATTACK_ToU-20.0.md`](../../LICENSES/MITRE_ATTACK_ToU-20.0.md), `NOTICES.md`).

79 of the 79 rules the agent can record map to 58 techniques and sub-techniques (32 of them sub-techniques) under 12 of the 15 Enterprise tactics. Each rule declares its references in code (`Rule::attack`); a detection record carries their ids in `mitre`, with `mitre_version` `20.0`. The rule catalogue ([`RULE_CATALOGUE.md`](RULE_CATALOGUE.md)) says what each rule observes; the ATT&CK Navigator layer ([`attack-navigator-layer.json`](attack-navigator-layer.json)) draws this table.

A technique listed here has at least one rule whose detection is evidence of it: it is not a claim that every procedure of the technique is detected, and MITRE's disclaimer applies (ATT&CK does not enumerate every way to perform a technique).

Validation: a rule in the V2 Critical sub-gate carries the status [`matrix.md`](../validation/matrix.md) gives it (`campaign`, `e2e`, `e2e-event`, `e2e-flaky`, `unit`, `no proof`); for any other rule it is the kinds of test the catalogue cites (`unit`, `e2e`, `lab`: a lab script that exercises the rule, not a recorded lab run), not reviewed row by row. The V2 campaign has not run (its sweep document says HALT): no row has campaign evidence.

## V2 rows without a rule

The pre-registered technique rows the campaign runs and reports as an anti-tamper denial, a signed integrity drift or a known gap, rather than as a rule's detection; a revoked id is given with its id in this version.

| Row | Technique | Expected | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| TQ01 | T1003.008 OS Credential Dumping: /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow | known-gap | No rule names it; NN-L-FIM-003 fires on a modification of these files, not a read. DETECT_ONLY_VALIDATION_2026-06-05 could not test a read as written. |
| TQ04 | T1021.004 Remote Services: SSH | known-gap | NN-L-NET-018 does not watch port 22. |
| TQ07 | T1033 System Owner/User Discovery | known-gap | No discovery rule (DETECT_ONLY_VALIDATION_2026-06-05). |
| TQ09 | T1049 System Network Connections Discovery | known-gap | No discovery rule (DETECT_ONLY_VALIDATION_2026-06-05). |
| TQ13 | T1055.008 Process Injection: Ptrace System Calls | denial | The ptrace_access_check hook refuses it; the anti-tamper suite reaches that hook only through /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/mem (see T1055.009). |
| TQ14 | T1055.008 Process Injection: Ptrace System Calls | known-gap | No rule; R016_DebuggerServiceUid names debugger tooling under a service uid only (T1622). |
| TQ15 | T1055.009 Process Injection: Proc Memory | denial | - |
| TQ16 | T1055.009 Process Injection: Proc Memory | known-gap | No rule. |
| TQ17 | T1057 Process Discovery | known-gap | No discovery rule (DETECT_ONLY_VALIDATION_2026-06-05). |
| TQ23 | T1070.004 Indicator Removal: File Deletion | known-gap | No rule for a deletion in general; a deleted watched file is a FIM drift row. |
| TQ24 | T1070.006 Indicator Removal: Timestomp | known-gap | No rule. |
| TQ27 | T1082 System Information Discovery | known-gap | No discovery rule (DETECT_ONLY_VALIDATION_2026-06-05). |
| TQ31 | T1480 Execution Guardrails | known-gap | A check the payload makes of its environment; no host event to judge. |
| TQ34 | T1497 Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion | known-gap | A check the payload makes of its environment; no host event to judge. |
| TQ35 | T1499 Endpoint Denial of Service | known-gap | NN-L-NET-020 and NN-L-NET-021 name DNS, listener and io_uring record floods (T1071.004, T1562.006); a flood of exec or open records has no rule. |
| TQ39 | T1547.013 Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: XDG Autostart Entries | known-gap | ~/.config/autostart is not watched (DETECT_ONLY_VALIDATION_2026-06-05). |
| TQ50 | T1562.001 (revoked; now T1685 Disable or Modify Tools) | drift | A signed integrity_drift, not a rule. |
| TQ51 | T1562.004 (revoked; now T1686 Disable or Modify System Firewall) | known-gap | No rule; whether a flushed COMBAT chain is detected or restored has not been established. |
| TQ53 | T1562.012 (revoked; now T1685.004 Disable or Modify Tools: Disable or Modify Linux Audit System Log) | known-gap | No rule; the agent does not read the Linux audit system. |
